primary_estimand.name: vendor-level pass rate
primary_estimand.definition: population mean over vendors in the frozen sample frame of the vendor's probability that a single fresh autonomous run PROVEN_SUCCEEDs the canonical journey on its first attempt under the natural customer condition
primary_estimand.estimator: equal-weight mean of per-vendor PROVEN_SUCCESS rate r_v

quantities.name: first-attempt success
quantities.numerator: PROVEN_SUCCESS with one permitted effect request, no rescue

quantities.name: independently verified effect rate
quantities.numerator: runs with verifier-confirmed exactly-one correct effect

quantities.name: time-to-effect
quantities.numerator: distribution of seconds to first verified effect

denominator_rules.indeterminate_vendor: vendor with zero eligible runs: r_v undefined; excluded from P_v vendor-mean but count+fraction reported as headline; never scored 0; never silently dropped

afcr_semantics: verified first product outcome within one autonomous attempt; read-only exploration unlimited; exactly one effect-creating request permitted
